topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Rain splatters the window, coloring the glass in a thousand shades of gray. Found your college essay out there, floating in the digital ether, did you? Must've been a shock. Some folks, they just can't keep a good thing to themselves. But here's the thing, kid – your words, they've got a life of their own now. And that’s not such a bad deal. Means they resonated, struck a chord. Maybe, just maybe, it’s a sign that they belong out there, doing more than just gathering dust on some admissions desk. Keeps it real, doesn’t it? Your thoughts, your dreams – they’re worth sharing. So, yeah, it's a rough break, but it’s also a kind of compliment. Keep your head up, and remember, your story’s still being written.
